name: Melchisedec
summary: The king of Salem and a priest of the most high God, who met Abram with bread and wine and blessed him. Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

key_moments.title: Brings Bread and Wine to Abram
key_moments.description: When Abram came back from defeating Chedorlaomer and the kings with him, Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God most high, came out with bread and wine.

key_moments.title: Blesses Abram and Receives a Tenth
key_moments.description: Melchizedek blessed Abram by the most high God, maker of heaven and earth, and praised God for giving Abram victory over his enemies. Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
